We are looking for a Domain Architect Applications and Middleware , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid / Remote , in the city of Belo Horizonte - MG.


In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Application and Middleware is primarily responsible for defining, supervising and evolving the architecture of applications and middleware in critical environments. Its mission will be to align strategic business needs with modern, resilient and scalable solutions, promoting homogeneous integration between core applications (ERP, mobile, automation, operation) and middleware platforms (ESB, API Management, messaging, OT/IT integration in mining). The role requires global collaborative action, directly with technical stakeholders of operations in Brazil and Canada, considering regulatory, technological and security requirements for highly critical and distributed environments.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Define and maintain domain architectural blueprints for applications and middleware, including architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and governance frameworks.
  • Conduct technical assessments, solution modeling, validation of integration requirements and support DevSecOps, Data, Operations and Business squads.
  • Lead the selection, implementation, and evolution of mission-critical middleware platforms (ESB, API Gateway, Message Brokers, iPaaS, Automation).
  • Drive modernization initiatives: cloud-native apps, containers, serverless, scalability, CI/CD automation, and API-first standards.
  • Ensure adherence to security policies, monitoring, resilience and local/global compliance – including LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA, SOX.
  • Orchestrate efficient integration between legacy and modern systems, promoting microservices-oriented architecture, events, and open APIs.
  • Act as a technical reference for the architecture of critical corporate applications (SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, industrial systems, mobile/IoT).
  • Support migrations to public and hybrid cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP), participating in the choice of tools (middleware, API management, observability, automation).
  • Produce and maintain detailed documentation, promoting reuse, good practices and training of local and international teams.
  • Foster technological innovation, implementing POCs and continuous benchmarking to adapt the best global trends to the context of mining and operations.
  • Participate in global forums, technical communities, events and selection processes for strategic suppliers.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Higher education in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or related areas.
  • Minimum of 8 years of solid experience in distributed application architecture and middleware platforms (including integration and automation).
  • Mastery of modern architecture patterns: SOA, Event-Driven, Microservices, API-first, DevSecOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code automation.
  • Proven experience in large mining, energy, industry, utilities or multinational companies.
  • Proficiência em plataformas middleware: IBM Integration Bus, MuleSoft, Tibco, Azure Integration Services, Red Hat Fuse, RabbitMQ/Kafka, Apigee/API Gateway, etc.
  • Expertise em cloud platforms: Azure (preferencial), AWS e GCP, cloud migration/hybrid, containers e automação (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).
  • History with ERP systems, industrial/SCADA/IoT systems, messaging, BPM, ETL and complex integrations (SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Mobile).
  • Advanced skills in documentation, modeling (UML, BPMN, ArchiMate), integration drawings (Ex: Sequence Diagrams, Logical Data Flows).
  • Fluent English (oral and written – requirement for Canada-Brazil work), Spanish and/or French are differentials.


Soft Skills

  • Technical leadership, influence, consensus building between multidisciplinary and multinational teams.
  • Analytical and strategic capacity seeking practical, scalable and secure solutions to global challenges.
  • Clear communication with stakeholders at different levels and cultures (technology, operation, business, global leadership).
  • Adaptability to the regulatory context of both countries, orientation to continuous improvement.
  • Autonomy, proactivity, collaboration and focus on delivering real value to operations.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certificações: Azure Solutions Architect, MuleSoft/IBM/Tibco Professional, RedHat Middleware, TOGAF, PMP, Scrum Master.
  • Experience with OT/IT integration, critical systems in mining 4.0, digital twins, remote automation, edge/fog computing.
  • Practical experience with cybersecurity standards (NIST, ISA/IEC 62443), observability/metrics, SRE.
  • Previous experience in global projects, mining, steel or oil & gas.
  • Participation in open innovation projects, global technical communities, publications, international events.


Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Clear and robust reference architectures for all, Brazil and Canada middleware application domains.
  • Efficient, resilient, and secure integration of critical systems, promoting automation, monitoring, and innovation in operational flows.
  • Migration of on-prem applications to hybrid cloud, redesign of API-oriented integrations and microservices.
  • Documentation of standards, integration policies, manuals, templates and training of technical teams.
  • Ensuring compliance, performance, scalability, and governance in mission-critical environments.
  • Acting as a transformation agent, guiding squads and international areas to new practices and technologies.
  • Amplification of the collaborative culture, global vision and focus on sustainable results for business.


Additional Comments:

The professional will be an essential part of technological evolution, driving integration, innovation and resilience in Brazil and Canada operations. It should be a protagonist in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments, with a business vision aligned with technical excellence. Previous experience in environments of high complexity and global impact is valued, as well as an innovative mindset and strategic partnership posture with global leadership and teams..

Coordenação de Agendas: Recebimento e processamento de solicitações de agendamento de sessões de homologação pelas Instituições Financeiras clientes.

Alocação de Recursos: Reserva de equipamentos, ambientes de teste, simuladores e equipe técnica de apoio conforme a demanda e o tipo de homologação.

Comunicação Pré-homologação: Envio de informações detalhadas sobre o ambiente de teste, pré-requisitos para a sessão e lista de documentos ou dados necessários para o homologador.

Suporte no Laboratório de Homologação

Recepção e Acolhimento: Recepcionar o responsável da Instituição Financeira no laboratório, orientando sobre as instalações e o ambiente de trabalho.

Configuração e Preparação: Preparar o ambiente de testes com as configurações, cadastramentos, dados e cenários necessários para a homologação a ser realizada.

Assistência Técnica Dedicada: Acompanhamento de um técnico ou especialista (quando necessário) para acompanhar o homologador durante toda a sessão de testes, oferecendo suporte para:

• Execução de casos de teste.

• Registro de evidências (logs, prints, vídeos).

• Simulação de cenários de transações.

• Análise preliminar de anomalias ou falhas.

Acesso a Ferramentas e Logs: Fornecer ao homologador acesso facilitado a ferramentas de monitoramento e logs dos sistemas para validação e depuração.

Intermediação com Equipes Internas: Atuar como ponte entre o homologador e as equipes internas de desenvolvimento ou suporte para resolução de dúvidas ou escalonamento de problemas encontrados durante a homologação.

Registro de Anomalias: Auxiliar no registro formal de quaisquer anomalias, bugs ou não conformidades identificadas, com detalhes suficientes para posterior análise e correção.

Documentação e Relatoria Pós-Homologação

Parecer de Homologação: Emissão de um parecer técnico sobre a homologação realizada, consolidando os resultados dos testes, status (aprovado/reprovado/pendente), anomalias encontradas e próximas etapas.

Evidências da Homologação: Compilação e disponibilização das evidências coletadas (logs, imagens, resultados de testes) para a Instituição Financeira cliente, conforme acordado.

Relatório de Sessão: Resumo da sessão de homologação, incluindo duração, participantes, equipamentos utilizados e um breve descritivo das atividades realizadas.

Análise de Requisitos: Compreender e analisar profundamente as especificações e requisitos do negócio, com foco em sistemas OLTP, para identificar cenários de teste abrangentes e eficientes.

Criação de Estratégias de Teste: Desenvolver planos e estratégias de testes sistêmicos e de integração, definindo escopo, tipos de teste e cobertura necessária para garantir a robustez dos sistemas.

Desenvolvimento de Casos de Teste: Criar e documentar casos de teste detalhados (incluindo testes funcionais e não funcionais), priorizando a rastreabilidade com os requisitos e a aplicação de conceitos de BDD (Behavior-Driven Development), quando aplicável.

Automação de Testes: Projetar, desenvolver e manter frameworks e scripts de automação para testes sistêmicos e de regressão, utilizando linguagens como Java ou Python, visando otimizar a cobertura, a velocidade e a repetibilidade dos testes.

Execução de Testes: Realizar a execução de testes automatizados e manuais, monitorar os resultados e registrar defeitos de forma clara, concisa e reproduzível.

Validação de Dados: Validação da integridade e consistência de dados em sistemas, assegurando que as transações e operações financeiras ocorram sem falhas.

Colaboração e Comunicação: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com desenvolvedores, analistas de negócios, POs e outras equipes, garantindo a qualidade do software desde as fases iniciais do ciclo de desenvolvimento.

Acompanhamento de Defeitos: Gerenciar o ciclo de vida dos defeitos, desde a identificação e registro até a correção e validação final.

Melhoria Contínua: Contribuir ativamente para a evolução dos processos de teste, ferramentas e metodologias, propondo soluções inovadoras para desafios de qualidade.

Experiência e m testes de software, com forte atuação em testes sistêmicos e de integração.

Automação de Testes: Experiência prática na criação e manutenção de automação de testes, com familiaridade em frameworks e ferramentas de mercado.

Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Java ou Python para o desenvolvimento de scripts e frameworks de automação.

BDD (Behavior-Driven Development): Compreensão e experiência na aplicação de princípios e ferramentas BDD (ex: Cucumber, Gherkin) para escrita de cenários de teste.

Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em SQL para consulta, validação e manipulação de dados em ambientes de teste.

Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência comprovada em trabalhar com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Ferramentas de Gerenciamento: Habilidade no uso de ferramentas de gerenciamento de casos de teste e defeitos (ex: Jira, Azure DevOps, TestLink).

Análise Crítica: Capacidade de analisar problemas complexos, identificar suas causas raiz e propor soluções eficazes.


Diferenciais

Setor Financeiro: Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras ou em projetos de desenvolvimento de sistemas bancários/financeiros.

Testes de API: Experiência com testes e automação de APIs (REST/SOAP) utilizando ferramentas como Postman, SoapUI ou frameworks específicos.

Testes de Performance: Familiaridade com ferramentas de testes de performance e carga (ex: JMeter, LoadRunner).

Integração Contínua/Entrega Contínua (CI/CD): Experiência na integração de testes automatizados em pipelines de CI/CD.

Cloud: Conhecimento em ambientes de nuvem (AWS).

title: Senior Network Support Engineer
description:
Senior Network Support Engineer / Resident Engineer - Brasilia


The Senior Resident Engineer is responsible for providing onsite technical support services to a specific NETSCOUT | Arbor customer and performing the role of a Subject Matter Expert on NETSCOUT | Arbor security products.


Specific Job Duties and Responsibilities

The Senior Resident Support Engineer relies on experience and judgment to plan and perform a variety of critical tasks / responsibilities pertaining to the customer’s NETSCOUT | Arbor deployment. These responsibilities require a high degree of autonomy and accountability and would include:


  • Work with and provide guidance/support to the customer’s operational and design staff, in the role of the NETSCOUT Arbor technical Subject Matter Expert.
  • Be a trusted advisor to the customer on all technical areas related to the NETSCOUT Arbor security products.
  • Design, implement, troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve normal and complex technical issues associated with NETSCOUT Arbor security products installed in the customer network.
  • Test and replicate customer configurations in a lab environment as and when required.
  • Ensure the operational and functional requirements pertaining to the NETSCOUT Arbor solution installed in the customer environment are fulfilled from a technical standpoint.
  • Track, investigate, escalate, and verify software defects as encountered and reported by customers
  • Deliver on-demand technical workshops on NETSCOUT security products, to the customer’s staff as needed.
  • Work with other NETSCOUT internal functions like technical support, engineering, and product management as needed related to product issues as well as new features.
  • Work closely with the NETSCOUT account team(s) of customer to understand and support the sales strategy from a technical standpoint.
  • Support the tuning and optimization requirements related to the NETSCOUT Arbor installation in the customer environment.
  • Assist and provide expert guidance to the customer security operations teams on security attack mitigations (pre-attack prep, during-attack assistance, post-attack reviews).
  • Develop and implement Method of Procedure documents for procedural and maintenance activities as required, related to the NETSCOUT Arbor products/solutions deployed in the customer environment.
  • Lead and support software upgrade activities or investigations of reported problems related to the NETSCOUT security products installed in the customer environment.
  • Work closely with the NETSCOUT Arbor Professional Services team to discuss, enhance, and share knowledge about product, domain, and solutions.
  • Generate customer-specific product technical documentation, as needed.
  • Continuously develop and update expertise on NETSCOUT products and solutions.
  • Develop and deliver technical presentations to customer and internal teams as needed.
  • Travel as required to customer sites and internationally for corporate events as needed

Experience and Educational Requirements


  • Bachelor’s Degree, or equivalent, in an associated area with 3+ years of experience in service delivery or technical support functions with strong fundamentals on telecom network and routing environments.
  • Advanced networking skills required (TCP/IP, Routing, BGP, MPLS, and related), NetFlow protocol experience and understanding desirable.
  • Strong network security skills required, knowledge of and experience in DDoS and mitigation techniques beneficial.
  • Knowledge of network test equipment network management protocols like SNMP, tools, and protocols like MRTG, SolarWinds.
  • Knowledge of internet and data security protocols like HTTP/S, SSL/TLS, DNS, VPN, IPSEC, GRE.
  • Intermediate to advanced knowledge in administration and provisioning of Unix/Linux and Solaris platforms, networking related scripting and automation skills desirable.
  • Expertise in packet analysis, debugging and troubleshooting, using tools like Wireshark/Tshark
  • Knowledge and experience on virtualization and cloud environment will be a strong skillset to have.
  • Ability to work independently and with where necessary.
  • Strong customer services and verbal/written communication/interpersonal skills.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, both verbal and written, is required. Knowledge of other languages is an added benefit.
  • Local Country Security Clearance may be required, if applicable in country.
  • Located On-Site in Brasilia

title: Coordenador (a) de Marketing
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?


Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.


Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.


No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².


Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.


No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.


A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.


Como nosso (a) Coordenador (a) de Marketing, você irá:


Tem como objetivo de ajustar nossa capacidade operacional e garantir o atendimento eficiente de todas as demandas de criação visual da empresa, fortalecendo a identidade visual da marca em diferentes canais e formatos.


  • Planejar, organizar e executar eventos institucionais, promocionais, internos e externos, como feiras, convenções, ativações, lançamentos e eventos comemorativos;
  • Conduzir a participação da empresa em feiras, patrocínios e associações estratégicas, liderando todo o processo — do briefing à entrega e avaliação pós-evento;
  • Coordenar inaugurações de lojas, eventos em filiais e visitas na matriz, garantindo excelência operacional e alinhamento com os objetivos de marca;
  • Implementar e assegurar a aplicação do manual de marca e eventos da companhia, garantindo padrão de qualidade nas inaugurações e ações de comunicação associadas;
  • Mapear e desenvolver relacionamento com associações relevantes dos setores em que a empresa atua, identificando oportunidades de colaboração, visibilidade e networking;
  • Negociar e gerir fornecedores (buffets, montadoras, brindes, locações, agências etc.), controlando prazos, orçamento e qualidade;

title: Analista de segurança da informação
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta oportunidade é para atuar em uma empresa parceira , líder em soluções e distribuição de peças , localizada em Porto Alegre/RS . Em fase de expansão, a companhia busca fortalecer sua área de Segurança da Informação , promovendo governança, controle e resiliência cibernética .

A posição é part-time , com jornada realizada às segundas, quartas e sextas-feiras .

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Liderar e participar de todo o ciclo de resposta a incidentes de segurança (detecção, contenção, erradicação, recuperação e lições aprendidas).
  • Monitorar eventos de segurança analisando logs de rede, servidores, endpoints, firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM , entre outros.
  • Gerenciar o programa de vulnerabilidades : varredura, priorização, remediação e relatórios.
  • Atuar com ameaças emergentes (threat hunting) , antecipando riscos e adaptando controles.
  • Apoiar a arquitetura de segurança e implementar soluções como SIEM/SOAR, EDR, DLP, WAF e ferramentas em nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP) .
  • Garantir conformidade com frameworks e normas (ISO 27001, NIST, PCI-DSS, LGPD) e apoiar auditorias.
  • Desenvolver políticas, procedimentos e programas de conscientização em segurança.
  • Traduzir riscos técnicos em impactos de negócio , comunicando-se com stakeholders e áreas executivas.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida e prática com SIEM, EDR, ferramentas de varredura de vulnerabilidades e monitoramento de logs .
  • Vivência em ambientes de nuvem pública ou híbrida (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para traduzir riscos técnicos em linguagem de negócios.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado , com pensamento crítico e facilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Certificações como CISSP, CISM, CISA ou certificações de segurança em nuvem (AWS/Azure Security).
  • Experiência com automação e orquestração de segurança (SOAR) e scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) .
  • Conhecimento do framework MITRE ATT&CK e inteligência de ameaças .
  • Experiência com auditorias, conformidade regulatória e privacidade de dados (LGPD, GDPR) .
  • Vivência em mentoria ou liderança técnica na área de segurança.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Presencial

title: Senior Software Test Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?

Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer


What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.

  • Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;

  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best result;
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
  • Review code and mentor (junior) engineers;
  • Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
  • Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.


What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
  • benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
  • focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
  • annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
  • tech events and knowledge sessions.


This will make you better:

  • contract for indefinite period of time;
  • an all-in employee benefit package ( €61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance;
  • good secondary employment conditions: i.a. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.


This will keep you healthy:

  • a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
  • an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
  • the home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
  • lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.


What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
  • You are capable of defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
  • A background in software development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
  • Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
  • You have proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
  • You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
  • Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.


Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.


Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

  • Implementar GitOps com ArgoCD para deploys consistentes e rastreáveis;
  • Definir e manter padrões de configuração, rede, armazenamento e RBAC;
  • Apoiar os times de desenvolvimento na publicação e troubleshooting de aplicações em containers.


Automação e Integrações

  • Criar e manter pipelines CI/CD reutilizáveis e seguros (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins);
  • Desenvolver scripts e automações em Python, Bash ou Go para tarefas de infraestrutura;
  • Integrar sistemas e APIs internas/externas (monitoramento, alertas, auditorias);
  • Automatizar a gestão de secrets e tokens (Vault, Doppler, AWS Secrets Manager);
  • Implementar práticas de monitoramento e observabilidade dos serviços (logs estruturados, métricas, tracing).


Segurança e Confiabilidade

  • Garantir que as esteiras CI/CD incluam validações básicas de segurança (SAST, secret scanning, lint);
  • Apoiar o controle de acesso entre serviços (OAuth2, JWT, API Keys);
  • Colaborar com times de segurança e auditoria em integrações e coleta de evidências.


Requisitos e qualificações:


Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:


  • Ensino Superior Completo em Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prática com Kubernetes, Rancher e automação de infraestrutura;
  • Conhecimento sólido em CI/CD e GitOps (ArgoCD, Jenkins, GitLab CI);
  • Experiência com containers (Docker) e infraestrutura Linux;
  • Conhecimento em Python, Go ou Shell Script para automação;
  • Familiaridade com Terraform, Ansible ou outras ferramentas de IaC;
  • Experiência com observabilidade e troubleshooting em ambientes distribuídos.


É um diferencial se você tiver:


  • Certificações em CKA/CKAD, Terraform, AWS ou Rancher;
  • Experiência em segurança de clusters Kubernetes e políticas RBAC/OPA;
  • Vivência com Vault ou outras ferramentas de gestão de segredos;
  • Conhecimento em Elastic Stack, Prometheus, Loki, Grafana;
  • Experiência com gestão de ambientes multi-cloud e automação de provisionamento.

We are looking for an IT Security Management Specialist, who will check and assess internal infrastructure for vulnerabilities, identify potential data breach risks, and address them for all Latin American subsidiaries. title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Enterprise Architect who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Job Description:


The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments.


Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position Vale as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects,
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.

Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.

Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

title: IT Security & Compliance Consultant
description:
About you

You are someone who provide security, compliance, and risk oversight and drive the creation of the detailed inventory and classification of installed applications—ensuring the taxonomy defined in the charter is implemented (name, version, publisher, category, description, EOL date, plus owner/team fields for future phases), data is normalized across Systems, and risks are surfaced with clear next steps.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred) or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5–7+ years of experience in security, compliance, or Software Asset Management (SAM) governance.
  • Hands-on experience with Intune, NinjaOne, and ServiceNow SAM.
  • Strong skills in data normalization, taxonomy design, and software lifecycle/EOL management.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen eye for data quality and governance.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to coordinate across technical and business teams.
  • Ability to document processes, identify risks, and provide structured recommendations.
  • Advanced English proficiency to interact effectively with global stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Detailed Inventory Build (Installed Apps): Lead aggregation from multiple sources; reconcile source differences; produce a single authoritative baseline of applications and versions for workstations, mobile devices, and servers.
  • Classification & Taxonomy Execution: Implement the charter’s taxonomy fields (Application name, Version, Publisher, Category, Description, End-of-life date; define placeholders for Primary Business Owner, Technical Owner, Team using the application for future phases). Ensure every discovered app is categorized per the defined category scheme and platform (Win/Mac/iOS/Android/Server).
  • Normalization Rules: Define and apply deduplication and normalization (e.g., normalize publisher strings, collapse installer variants, consolidate minor version drift) so each entry represents a canonical application + version.
  • Quality & Coverage Checks: Establish data-quality gates (required fields populated for scope; minimal “Unknown publisher” entries; alignment of device coverage to endpoints in scope). Maintain an Excluded Items log for anything out-of-scope with rationale.
  • Security/EOL Enrichment: Add security-relevant attributes/workflows (EOL flagging, vulnerable/high-risk categories, privileged tools). Create a practical CVE lookup workflow for later phases; prioritize EOL and obviously risky categories.
  • Validation with Business: Facilitate validation sessions with Managing Directors/Dept Leads to confirm the catalog reflects reality; capture deltas and residual risks.
  • Risk Assessment & Inputs to Roadmap: Document findings (unsupported software, shadow IT indicators, risky categories) and quick wins that feed the implementation roadmap/policies (policy drafting is later-phase).


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a global software leader in technology-enabled digital insights and research technology. The Cint platform automates the insights-gathering process so that companies can gain access to insights faster with unparalleled scale. Cint has one of the world’s largest consumer networks for digital survey-based research, made up of over 239 million engaged respondents across more than 130 countries. Job Description

Overview

We are looking for an exceptional and highly experienced Staff Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our quality engineering team. This is a crucial individual contributor role responsible for designing, building, and maintaining advanced test automation frameworks, driving innovative testing practices, and significantly raising the quality bar across the entire development lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a deep technical expert and a proactive mentor.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Design & Framework Ownership

  • Architect and Develop: Design, develop, and implement highly scalable, reliable, and maintainable test automation frameworks from scratch across multiple platforms (e.g., web, API, backend services).

  • Technical Authority: Serve as the technical authority on testing methodologies, tools, and best practices. Evaluate and integrate new automated tools and technologies into the existing test infrastructure.

  • Code Quality: Drive high standards for test code quality, structure, and maintainability, including code reviews for automation scripts and framework contributions from SDET team.

  • Non-Functional Testing: Design and execute advanced non-functional tests, including performance and load tests, and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline.

Quality Strategy & Process Improvement

  • Quality Advocate: Partner with development and product teams to integrate testing practices early in the development lifecycle (Shift-Left). Advocate for and implement robust quality gates and coverage metrics.

  • CI/CD Integration: Own and optimize the integration of automated tests into the Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipeline to ensure rapid feedback and zero defect leakage to production.

  • Troubleshooting: Expertly debug and analyze complex system failures, identifying root causes in both application code and test infrastructure.

Mentorship & Leadership

  • Mentorship: Coach and mentor junior and mid-level SDETs and software engineers on technical design, testing strategy, and effective automation techniques.

  • Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for test strategies, automation frameworks, and best practices to enable self-service quality for all engineers.

  • Technical Strategy: Contribute significantly to the long-term quality roadmap and technology choices alongside Engineering Managers and Principal Engineers.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

  • Minimum of 7+ years of professional experience in a hands-on SDET, Automation Engineer, or Quality Engineer role.

  • Expert proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C#, Go) used for building production-level code and automation frameworks.

  • Proven experience designing and scaling test automation frameworks (e.g., using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or equivalents) for complex, large-scale applications.

  • Deep practical knowledge of CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, data structures, and algorithms.

  • Excellent ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and influence cross-functional technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a domain-specific area (e.g., cloud infrastructure, machine learning, financial systems).

  • Experience with advanced mocking/stubbing tools and service virtualization.

  • Certifications in cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

title: Senior Software Test Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?


“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."


Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer


What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Software Test Designer:

  • Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;
  • Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and development of tools for qualification and integration;
  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best result;
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
  • Review code and mentor (junior) engineers;
  • Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
  • Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.


What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
  • benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
  • focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
  • annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
  • tech events and knowledge sessions.


This will make you better:

  • contract for indefinite period of time;
  • an all-in employee benefit package ( €61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance;
  • good secondary employment conditions: i.a. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.


This will keep you healthy:

  • a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
  • an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
  • the home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
  • lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.


What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
  • You are capable of defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
  • A background in software development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
  • Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
  • You have proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
  • You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
  • Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.


Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.


Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Repórter Investigativo de Política
description:
Sobre o Bastidor


Somos um veículo criado por Diego Escosteguy com a missão de iluminar os segredos do poder. Nossa matéria-prima são notícias exclusivas e de alto impacto, seja por meio de informações sintéticas, seja por meio de reportagens profundas. Cobrimos assuntos e casos difíceis, que envolvem grandes personagens da vida política e econômica nacional. Praticamos jornalismo independente e apartidário com rigor profissional, mediante investigação crítica de fatos de interesse público.


Valorizamos trabalho em equipe, apuração constante junto a fontes humanas e uso avançado de ferramentas digitais e de IA para obtenção, checagem e análise de fontes documentais.


Sobre a vaga


Procuramos um repórter investigativo para cobrir, majoritariamente, Congresso Nacional. Experiência é desejável, mas não é o mais importante; buscamos talentos que tenham disposição para aprender e vontade de se tornar um grande repórter. Nossa cobertura de Câmara e Senado envolve tanto movimentos de bastidor e articulações políticas quanto acompanhamento crítico e fiscalizador de assuntos relevantes - sempre sob a supervisão de nossos editores.


Responsabilidades


  • Mapear, priorizar e explicar pautas de alto impacto (plenário e comissões).
  • Ler e interpretar pareceres, relatórios, emendas, LOA/LDO, diários e atas.
  • Construir e preservar fontes (lideranças, relatorias, consultorias, assessorias, mercado) com ética.
  • Investigar trilhas documentais (Portal da Transparência, ComprasGov, e‑SIC/LAI, TCU).
  • Trabalhar em parceria com editores e colegas para desenvolver pautas próprias e séries investigativas.
  • Usar ferramentas digitais/IA para triagem, verificação e organização de materiais.


Requisitos (obrigatórios)


  • Graduação em Jornalismo (concluída).
  • Domínio da Língua Portuguesa (clareza, lógica, gramática e edição).
  • Técnicas básicas de apuração (entrevista, checagem, leitura de documentos).
  • Conhecimento básico do Legislativo brasileiro (regimento, tramitação, orçamento).
  • Predisposição para construir e preservar fontes com ética e responsabilidade.
  • Independência e apartidarismo; julgamento editorial equilibrado.
  • Espírito crítico, curiosidade intelectual, trabalho em equipe e abertura a feedback.
  • Conforto com planilhas e pesquisa em bases públicas; disposição para aprender IA.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)


  • Vivência em Brasília/legislativo; leitura avançada de regimento.
  • Noções de dados (limpeza, cruzamento) e/ou Python/SQL.
  • Inglês de leitura.


O que você aprenderá no Bastidor


  • Técnicas avançadas de reportagem e produção de exclusivas de alto impacto.
  • Pesquisa e obtenção de evidências jornalisticamente úteis (bases públicas e privadas).
  • Análise empírica e lógica de evidências e valoração criteriosa de fatos (epistemologia aplicada ao jornalismo).
  • Redação assertiva, equilibrada e clara, sem clichês, ilações ou hipérboles.
  • Uso avançado de IA e ML para organização, pesquisa e análise de casos.
  • Segurança operacional (física e digital) e proteção de fontes e documentos.


Como se candidatar


Pelo LinkedIn ou envie seu currículo para com "Repórter Investigativo de Política" e seu nome no campo de assunto. Inclua links para até três reportagens de sua autoria e um texto de até 300 palavras que descreva por que você quer trabalhar conosco.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Enterprise Architect who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Job Description:


The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments.


Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position Vale as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects,
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.

Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.

Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.
